findings.finding: The two sheets and the glue were authored by hand. The unit's Goal says each sheet is 'authored by a content do stamped sheet-craft', and Details says to author them 'under this unit's frame as do children' and 'judge them against rules/composition.md and docs/custom-workflow-authoring.md with bounded-repair'. No ticket for that stage exists in either sink: the main run has B1.32 alone (no B1.32.x), b132h holds only the three browser-fps runs, and `grep -rl sheet-craft b132h/state` is empty. Deviation 3 discloses that 'the children were executed by me in place', but its sentence describes the browser-fps run's children, which do have tickets, seals and digests; the authoring stage had no ticket at all, so the sheet-craft sheet was never stamped on these sheets and no judge read the glue against composition.md. The end state the unit's Done freezes holds (both sheets validate under orchflows check, the glue resolves and ran), and my own read of the glue against composition.md items 1, 2, 4, 5, 10, 12, 13 finds no violation, so nothing frozen is false; what is missing is the ladder's own stage over its own first sheets.
